note: Fictional example entries for the product Acme Notes. Edit a real registry with research/tools/registry.mjs.

tests.idea: Quote the exact title text in the prompt for generated cover images
tests.question: Does the cover show the title spelled correctly?
tests.variants: vague wording vs exact quoted text
tests.result: Title correct in 6 of 6 with quotes; 2 of 6 without. Small sample: evidence, not statistics. Verdict: Adopt.

tests.idea: Add a handwritten font look to note cards
tests.question: Do reviewers prefer the handwritten look?
tests.result: No preference in 3 of 4 reviewers. Verdict: Drop.
tests.action: no action: no preference shown, not worth the build cost

tests.idea: Summarise long notes with a two-step outline-first prompt
tests.question: Is the outline-first summary judged better by people?
